facts.fact: Kenrokuen is a Maeda landscape garden beside the castle, with Kasumigaike Pond and seasonal yukitsuri protection. Adult admission JPY320; 08:00–17:00 from October16 through the end of February, otherwise07:00–18:00. Seasonal appearance is not guaranteed.
